title: Slack Pro to self-hosted Zulip
summary: Zulip's threaded topics are a different shape of chat — better for decisions, worse for banter, and free of per-seat pricing.

you_lose: Slack's familiar single-stream interface — Zulip's topic threading divides people
Huddles; Zulip has voice/video via Jitsi integration but it is not the same
you_gain: Topics make a busy channel readable, which is the one thing Slack has never solved
Apache-2.0 with no edition matrix — every feature is in the free self-hosted build
Message history and search that never hit a 90-day wall

caveats: Zulip is opinionated: every message goes in a topic. Teams that fight itbounce off; teams that adopt it rarely go back. Do a two-week pilot before moving a whole workspace.
Import from Slack is first-party (they ship a tooling path for it), which is unusual — the 9-hour estimate assumes it works on your export.
